Hi Sally —

Thanks again for the call this morning. We submitted the ACE registration on your behalf (I attached the completed form) and copied the PDM/PSM who will partner with you through the co-sell runway. Quick summary of next steps: 

- Laura (PDM): will validate solution fit and coordinate the AWS-side readiness checklist.
- Aditya (PSM): will own the deal orchestration and go-to-market artifacts for co-sell.
- Procurement: if you can share a standard PO/contact for marketplace invoicing that helps speed procurement review.

Can you confirm: 1) the primary contact for the AWS security questionnaire (name/email), and 2) your preferred time window for a 30-min handshake call this week (PST preferred)?

Attached: ACE-Registration-form.pdf (filled)

Thanks — looking forward to getting the handshake scheduled so we can align PDM/PSM/APIs.

Best,

Proposed agenda for the 30-min handshake:
1) Introductions & roles (5 min)
2) High-level timeline for ACE co-sell (10 min)
3) Security/questionnaire owners & timelines (5 min)
4) Procurement path & PO timing (5 min)
5) Immediate blockers and next steps (5 min)

Suggested slots (PST): Wed 6/16 09:30–10:00, Wed 6/16 10:30–11:00, Thu 6/17 09:00–09:30. Sally/Jason — please pick one and I'll send a calendar invite.

Links & attachments:
- MAP (working): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aB-aurum-map
- Attachment: AurumSoft-MAP-v1.xlsx
